title: Fixed several `Formulas` plugin defects: `loadData()` and `updateData()` discarded a formula whose text had changed, writing the engine's previous formula back in its place; `setSourceDataAtCell()` addressed the wrong engine row on a sorted or moved grid, silently overwriting whichever cell it collided with; detaching a row with the `NestedRows` plugin wrote `#REF!` over a formula whose target still existed, and read a cell's `valueGetter` from the wrong row; and autofilling read the source cell's configuration from another cell when rows or columns were trimmed or moved.
